translations.literal: Afterward in the commandery men shivered though it was not cold.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the whole commandery shivered though it was not cold.

sentences.zh: 是時，趙禹、張湯以深刻為九卿。

translations.literal: At this time Zhao Yu and Zhang Tang, by severity and depth, were among the Nine Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Zhao Yu and Zhang Tang, by their harsh severity, were among the Nine Ministers.

sentences.zh: 然其治尚輔法而行；

translations.literal: Yet their governance still assisted the law in execution;
translations.idiomatic: Yet their governance still assisted the law in execution;

sentences.zh: 縱專以鷹擊為治。

translations.literal: Zong alone used hawk-strikes as governance.
translations.idiomatic: Zong alone governed by hawk-like strikes.

sentences.zh: 王溫舒始為廣平都尉，擇郡中豪敢往吏十餘人，以為爪牙，皆把其陰重罪，而縱使督盜賊。

translations.literal: Wang Wenshu at first was Commandant of Guangping; he chose more than ten bold and daring officials of the commandery as claws and teeth, all grasping their hidden heavy crimes, and indulged them to oversee bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wenshu at first was Commandant of Guangping; he chose more than ten bold officials of the commandery as his claws and teeth, all holding their hidden capital crimes over them, and set them loose to hunt bandits.

sentences.zh: 快其意所欲得，此人雖有百罪，弗法；

translations.literal: When they pleased his mind in what they wished to obtain, though such a man had a hundred crimes, no law was applied;
translations.idiomatic: When they pleased him in what he wished to obtain, though such a man had a hundred crimes, no law was applied;

sentences.zh: 即有避，因其事夷之，亦滅宗。

translations.literal: if there was evasion, by their affair he exterminated them and also destroyed the clan.
translations.idiomatic: if there was evasion, he exterminated them on that pretext and destroyed the clan as well.

sentences.zh: 以其故，齊、趙之郊盜賊不敢近廣平，廣平聲為道不拾遺。

translations.literal: Because of this, in the outskirts of Qi and Zhao bandits did not dare approach Guangping; Guangping's reputation was that on the road nothing was picked up if lost.
translations.idiomatic: Because of this, bandits in the outskirts of Qi and Zhao did not dare approach Guangping; Guangping's reputation was that nothing was left on the road.

sentences.zh: 遷河內太守，以九月至，令郡具私馬五十匹為驛，捕郡中豪猾，相連坐千餘家。

translations.literal: Transferred to be Administrator of Henei, he arrived in the ninth month, ordered the commandery to supply fifty private horses as relay mounts, captured the commandery's powerful scoundrels, and by linked guilt implicated more than a thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Administrator of Henei, he arrived in the ninth month, ordered the commandery to supply fifty private horses as relay mounts, captured the commandery's powerful scoundrels, and by linked guilt implicated more than a thousand households.

sentences.zh: 上書請，大者至族，小者乃死，家盡沒入償臧。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting that the great cases reach clan extermination, the small end in death, and households all confiscated to repay stolen goods.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized requesting that the great cases reach clan extermination, the small end in death, and households all confiscated to repay stolen goods.

sentences.zh: 奏行不過二三日得可，事論報，至流血十餘里，河內皆怪其奏，以為神速。

translations.literal: Memorials went out and in no more than two or three days received approval; when cases were judged and reported, blood flowed for more than ten li; all in Henei marveled at his memorials, thinking them divinely swift.
translations.idiomatic: Memorials went out and in no more than two or three days received approval; when cases were judged and reported, blood flowed for more than ten li; all in Henei marveled at his memorials, thinking them divinely swift.

sentences.zh: 盡十二月，郡中毋聲，毋敢夜行，野無犬吠之盜。

translations.literal: By the end of the twelfth month, in the commandery there was no sound; none dared travel at night; in the wilds there were no bandits of whom dogs barked.
translations.idiomatic: By the end of the twelfth month the commandery was silent; none dared travel at night; in the wilds there were no bandits to set dogs barking.

sentences.zh: 其頗不得，失之旁郡國，追求。

translations.literal: Those he largely could not obtain he lost to neighboring commanderies and kingdoms and pursued.
translations.idiomatic: Those he largely could not catch he pursued into neighboring commanderies and kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 會春，溫舒頓足歎曰：「嗟乎！

translations.literal: It happened to be spring; Wenshu stamped his foot and sighed, saying: "Alas!
translations.idiomatic: It happened to be spring; Wenshu stamped his foot and sighed, saying, "Alas!

sentences.zh: 令冬月益展一月，足吾事矣！

translations.literal: If only the winter month could be extended one more month, it would be enough for my affairs!
translations.idiomatic: If only the winter month could be extended one more month, it would be enough for my work!

sentences.zh: 天子聞之，皆以為能，故擢為中二千石。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven heard this and all considered him capable; therefore he was promoted to the two-thousand-bushel rank.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor heard this and all considered him capable; therefore he was promoted to the two-thousand-bushel rank.

sentences.zh: ----6齊人少翁，以鬼神方見上。

translations.literal: ----6 Shao Weng of Qi, by arts of spirits and ghosts, was received in audience by the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: ----6 Shao Weng of Qi, by arts of spirits and ghosts, was received in audience by the emperor.

sentences.zh: 上有所幸王夫人卒，少翁以方夜致鬼，如王夫人之貌，天子自帷中望見焉。

translations.literal: The emperor's favored Lady Wang died; Shao Weng by his art at night summoned a ghost resembling Lady Wang's appearance; the Son of Heaven from within the curtain gazed and saw it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's favored Lady Wang died; Shao Weng by his art at night summoned a ghost resembling Lady Wang; the emperor gazed from within the curtain and saw it.

sentences.zh: 於是乃拜少翁為文成將軍，賞賜甚多，以客禮禮之。

translations.literal: Thereupon he was appointed Wencheng General, with rewards very many, and treated with guest ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he was appointed Wencheng General, richly rewarded, and treated with guest ceremony.

sentences.zh: 文成又勸上作甘泉宮，中為台室，畫天、地、太一諸鬼神而置祭具，以致天神。

translations.literal: Wencheng again urged the emperor to build Sweet Spring Palace; within he made a terrace chamber, painted Heaven, Earth, Grand Unity, and the various spirits and ghosts, and set out sacrificial implements to summon the celestial god.
translations.idiomatic: Wencheng again urged the emperor to build Sweet Spring Palace; within he made a terrace chamber, painted Heaven, Earth, Grand Unity, and the various spirits, and set out sacrificial implements to summon the celestial god.

sentences.zh: 居歲餘，其方益衰，神不至。

translations.literal: After residing more than a year, his arts daily declined; the god did not come.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year his arts declined; the god did not come.

sentences.zh: 乃為帛書以飯牛，佯不知，言曰：「此牛腹中有奇。

translations.literal: He thereupon made a silk book to feed the ox, feigning ignorance, and said: "This ox's belly holds something marvelous.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon made a silk book to feed the ox, feigning ignorance, and said, "This ox's belly holds something marvelous.

sentences.zh: 」殺視，得書，書言甚怪，天子識其手書，問其人，果是偽書。

translations.literal: " He killed it and looked; he obtained the book; the book's words were very strange; the Son of Heaven recognized his own handwriting and questioned the man—it was indeed a forged book.
translations.idiomatic: " He killed it and looked; he obtained the book; its words were very strange; the emperor recognized his handwriting and questioned the man—it was indeed a forged book.

sentences.zh: 於是誅文成將軍而隱之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Wencheng General was executed and the matter concealed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Wencheng General was executed and the matter concealed.
